summary: Local USD rate workbook for the Durham formulation and early CMC group, revision B. It sets out the Vehicle ladder and Excipient compatibility screen work packages, optional pilot-lot handoff support, and the approval path for discounts. Rates are scoped per work package; discounts beyond the standard band go to the CMC Lead for sign-off.

rows: Early CMC rate card, USD, revision B
Two-week screen with bench sheet per vehicle. No volume discount
Pairwise mixes, screen suitability checked before the first read

The Vehicle ladder rate is the 2025 list price. Other lines are quoted at scoping against the work package, and this card does not commit a price for a formulation set that has not been scoped.

rows: Solubility and viscosity across a graded vehicle set at a fixed dose
